items.q: Which grade levels do you support?
items.a: We support high school students (Secondary 1 to 5, regular and enriched profiles) and CEGEP students.

High school: math and science (regular and enriched), physics, programming, French and Secondary 4 and 5 ministry exam preparation. CEGEP: differential and integral calculus, linear algebra, probability and statistics, mechanics, electricity and magnetism, waves and modern physics, general and solution chemistry, cell biology, programming in science, French 101, 102, 103 and EUF preparation.

items.q: What does the $500 monthly plan include?
items.a: The monthly plan includes 12 hours of in-person support per week, combining academic tutoring and personal development. It is billed automatically every month.

items.q: What is the difference between in-person and online tutoring?
items.a: The content and quality of support are the same. In person, the tutor sits beside the student ($45/h). Online, the session takes place by video call ($30/h).
You choose the number of hours in the form, then pay online by card. Applicable taxes are added at checkout.
You receive a confirmation email and a team member contacts you to schedule sessions and match your child with the right tutor.

items.q: My child isn't struggling. Can tutoring still help?
items.a: Yes. Tutoring and personal development also help students who want to aim higher, get better organized or gain confidence.
